subject.title: Subagent announce give-up (retry-limit/expiry) does not wake parent waiting on sessions_yield → permanent deadlock

question: Should the fix for this issue include new configurable announce retry/expiry knobs, or should it stay limited to durable parent wake/failure delivery?
rationale: The requester wake bug is concrete, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md set a high bar for new config surface, and the open focused PR explicitly leaves those knobs out of scope.

options.title: Keep fix focused
options.body: Land a durable parent wake/failure delivery fix first and leave retry/expiry hardening as a separate design item only if still needed.

options.title: Add config knobs now
options.body: Require the fix path to include documented, tested retry/expiry configuration despite the added compatibility and support surface.

options.title: Choose durable queue first
options.body: Pause narrow fixes and sponsor the broader persisted announce queue proposal as the canonical solution.

recommendation.title: Keep fix focused
recommendation.body: Land a durable parent wake/failure delivery fix first and leave retry/expiry hardening as a separate design item only if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent task delivery policy history make this the strongest available owner signal for the delivery-policy decision.
